column1: # The statement classes of the README benchmark section (bench/steps/glance.py): class<TAB>case<TAB>baseline<TAB>analytic.
# A class is shown by ONE case, the candidate with the largest absolute gap in milliseconds (either way: a case where the baseline is ahead can be the one) at the largest size measured.
# baseline: the lane pg_sift is compared with: `native` (the heap plan of PostgreSQL) or `btree` (the b-tree variant of the case, which a LIMIT or a lookup is compared with).
# analytic: yes puts pg_duckdb and DuckDB beside the class (the analytic classes only).
# An analytic class lists only cases that bench/steps/generic.py (suite orders) runs on pg_duckdb and DuckDB, so the engines can stand beside the representative.
